market_definition: The polychloroprene contact adhesives market comprises solvent-borne, waterborne and graft-modified adhesives based on chloroprene rubber applied to both surfaces before bonding. It measures sales of finished contact adhesives for footwear, laminates and furniture. BY CARRIER SYSTEM: Solvent-Borne, Waterborne, Graft-Modified / Low-VOC. BY APPLICATION METHOD: Brush / Roller, Spray, Other Methods. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Footwear & Leather Goods, Furniture & Laminates, Automotive Interiors, Construction & Countertops, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Spray adhesives sold in aerosol format; SBR latex adhesives; polychloroprene rubber sold as raw polymer. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
